lang: Test 1 - Launch and then kill a process with all possible cmd line args

comment: Start a new process with extra command line args
Check that the launch is logged as successful
Wait for process to start
Attempt to connect to the new process
Check that connection has been made
Check that the cmd line args are as expected
Find the PID of the launched process
Kill the process
Check that the kill is logged as successful
Wait for process to be terminated
Check that the handle to the process is no longer open
Check that the PID of the old process is no longer in use

lang: Test 2 - Launch and then kill a process with no extra cmd line args, to test defaulting

comment: Start a new process with no extra command line args, hence relying on defaulting in cloudutils.q
Check that the launch is logged as successful
Wait until the process can be found (up to 10 seconds): in discovery, or in its port file when discovery is off
Find process port from discovery services (from its port file when discovery is off)
Attempt to connect to the process
Check that connection has been made
Check that correct process name and type are present in the cmd line args of the process
Check that the expected default parameters for the U,localtime and p flags are present in the cmd line args
Find the PID of the launched process
Kill the process
Check that the kill is logged as successful
Wait for process to be terminated
Check that the handle to the process is no longer open
Check that the PID of the old process is no longer in use
